body.statement: The instance \(\mathcal I_{\mathrm{plat}}\) is canonical, minimal, and LV-SEM-ME rank-faithful. Among its thirty-two legal reconstructions, \(e^{\star}=12\), and exactly four completions attain the optimum: each selects \(N_i\) as the structural noise, selects \(c_2\) as the third center, and independently selects \(c_i\) or \(l_i\) as the first two centers. The choice \(((c_0,N_0),(c_1,H_1),(l_2,N_2))\) has thirteen edges, every one-group change has at least thirteen edges, and a simultaneous repair of the second noise and third center attains twelve.
body.justification: The faithful plateau rules out strict coordinate descent and any additive per-group edge score before they can contaminate the main algorithm.
body.gap: Neither Yang et al.'s Cartesian enumeration nor adjacent equivalence-class enumeration papers isolate a faithful coupled-cancellation benchmark of this form.
body.consumer: Any proposed polynomial completion solver must recover this exact optimum and four-model plateau as its first destructive unit test.
